faq.headline: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: WebContent is a platform that connects brands with creators. You create a campaign, creators apply, and you choose the best ones. All communication, payments, and content delivery happen directly on the platform.
faq.q2: Is it possible to approve scripts and content before it's produced?
faq.a2: Yes, you can review and approve scripts and storyboards before creators begin production. You have full control over the content.
faq.q3: How do I choose the right creators?
faq.a3: You can browse creator profiles with samples of previous work, statistics, and reviews. We handpick and quality-test all creators on the platform.
faq.q4: What does it cost to use the platform?
faq.a4: The SOLO plan is free. You only pay for the content you approve. The SCALE plan costs €149/month with a lower marketplace fee of 9%.
faq.a5: Yes, all rights to the content are transferred to you upon approval and payment. You can use the content for paid ads, organic posts, and more.
faq.q6: Can I use the platform for multiple brands?
faq.a6: The SCALE plan supports multi-brand and multi-user, perfect for agencies. The SOLO plan is limited to one brand.
faq.a7: Payment is handled directly on the platform. You only pay for approved content, and creators receive payment automatically.
faq.q8: Is it possible to get content for paid ads?
faq.a8: Yes, all content is optimized for use in paid ads on Meta, TikTok, and other platforms.
faq.a9: There is no lock-in period. You can downgrade or cancel your subscription at any time.
